changes_before_any_run.reason: The room's check (e) gates penalties, because the actor climbs a penalty during training, and a penalty that falls past 80% rewards the first steps of over-throttle. A trigger is never climbed: it only decides at each step whether the fallback takes over, so its shape decides nothing here and no trigger is gated on it. Without the readout, though, a reader cannot tell whether a trigger's catches in strong current come from the command (its firing rate rises past 80%) or only from the unusual state (its rate is flat across throttles). The reviewer's read-only check on seed 0 (stalling world, gapped critic's actor) found, for example, that the re-referenced one-step oracle falls from 80% to 81% on 5.4% of the states and fires on 6% at 80% and 72% at full throttle, while two-head disagreement falls on 43.9% and fires on 2-3% at every throttle. A rerun of that check reproduced every number.

deviations.what: plain TD3+BC in the no-stall world is the stalling world's TD3+BC actor deployed there (its own input normalisation; the no-stall world's data, critic, cloned actor, range and anchors for triggers, fallbacks and points); the stalling world's gapped critic's actor is deployed there too, as its same-actor companion (reported)
deviations.why: the gate trained TD3+BC hosts only in the stalling world (check 2 saved td3bc_gapped only there); training a no-stall TD3+BC would be a new training run, outside this no-training component

deviations.what: the one-step trigger is re-referenced to r(s), the recording controller's own command at the state without its wobble, in place of the row's recorded command a_i (room change A1); the cloned actor's command is reported as the other reference, the plan's literal |delta*| as a third
deviations.why: a deployment state has no recorded command, and the level must come from the same function of (state, command) at held-out pairs; with a_i itself every held-out score is 0 and the level is 0

deviations.what: the critic-based triggers read the deployment world's frozen fixed-controller gapped critic for every actor, plain TD3+BC included (its own co-trained critic is not read)
deviations.why: it is the room test's oracle critic and the plan's 'frozen critic'; a deployment check is a function of the (state, command) pair, so both actors face the same check; no no-stall TD3+BC critic exists

deviations.what: the distance check (sa95) is re-run with the clip fallback only (reported)
deviations.why: cost: its neighbour search is the slowest trigger (about 20 s per rule and situation); its cloned-actor numbers exist in the fallback diagnostic

deviations.what: the levels use the whole held-out calibration split outside the removed ball, not only its non-bank rows (Variant B's tau)
deviations.why: no band is calibrated on the bank here; this keeps the fallback diagnostic's rows and levels; bank rows are about 5% of them

deviations.what: the classifier is fitted once per seed, world and actor, not refitted every 4,000 steps (plan 4.2)
deviations.why: nothing is trained here; the deployed actor is fixed

deviations.open_question: whether the override is used at all is the user's decision; it was raised with the first spec and is not decided here
deviations.what: launch condition: after the room test's pooled look passes, as instructed; with --after-room-failure also after a room failure: a pooled look that did not pass, or a stop at the room's futility look, when no pooled look is ever written (change C2)
deviations.why: the instruction gates this component on the room's pooled look; plan 4.8 keeps the deployment check when the room fails (its 'room fails' and 'recovery fails' rows both say so), and a futility stop is the room's early way of failing, so the override exists for both and is recorded in every output and in the pooled summary

fallbacks.cap80: gate check only: the actor's command capped at +-0.8
fallbacks.clip99: primary: the actor's command clipped per thruster to the recorded range, the 0.5% and 99.5% quantiles of the gapped training commands (fallback.Reference lo99 / hi99; checked equal to the room harness's hinge_bounds)
fallbacks.clone: reported: the deployment world's cloned actor's command

gate_check: world-matched jobs, every situation, before the rules: never switching and capping at 80% on the whole 1,000-start bank reproduce check 2's saved points and capped points within 1e-6, else the job stops (stop_<job>.json); cross-world jobs: not applicable

heldout.check_rows: fallback.Reference's 5,000 evaluation-split rows outside the removed ball; the share above each level is reported (about 5% expected)
heldout.level_rows: the calibration split (200 recorded episodes no learner saw) minus rows whose command is in the removed ball: about 16,800 rows, exactly fallback.Reference's
heldout.level_rule: q95 = the ceil((n + 1) * 0.95)-th smallest score at those rows (fallback.conformal_threshold)

inherited_from_room_spec.change: A1 main oracle re-referenced to the recorded command

main_penalty.amended: change A1 (changes_before_any_run): the plan's literal |delta*(s, a)| is the reported arm perfect_band_literal
main_penalty.logged: delta*(s_i, a_i) is computed once per training row with the same in-program float32 function and the same next command as the arm (shared['d_logged']); a constant in training
main_penalty.meaning: the critic's extra overrating of the command a over the row's own recorded command a_i, by its exact one-step error; zero at a = a_i; the one-step counterpart of the long-run harm arm [e(s, a) - e(s, a_i)]_+

interpretations: Every score-based trigger, the classifier ratio included, uses the same rule as Variant B's tau and the plan's one-step trigger: above its 95% level on held-out recorded pairs.

The mark's 'at least 15 points' and 'cost at most 3' are pooled means of per-seed paired differences (as the room spec made its room mark exact); the plan gives no seed count for this mark, so seed counts are reported, not gated.
The mark is read on the gapped critic's actor (the plan's main actor; the room test's baseline); plain TD3+BC's reading is reported.
'Cost in recorded conditions' is the actor alone minus the perfect detector with the clip fallback.
Selectivity follows plan 4.2's 'stalling-world gain minus no-stall loss' and plan 4.4's catch-rate difference.

The room's check (e) (a penalty must rise past 80%) gates penalties, which the actor climbs in training. Triggers are not climbed, so no trigger is gated on its shape; the shape is reported (change C4).
label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 deployment-check channel (plan section 4.3), computed outside the gate on saved gate actors; no training; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update was used (stand-ins and oracles only)

launch.condition: a full job runs only after the room test's pooled look: runs/shift_explore/room/pooled.json for the pinned room spec, labelled, with its room, recovery and keeps-improvement marks passed. --after-room-failure lets it run after a room failure (plan 4.8: the deployment check remains): a pooled look that did not pass, or, when no pooled.json exists, a futility look that stopped the room (runs/shift_explore/room/futility.json for the pinned room spec, labelled; only its stop flag is read). A futility look that says continue, with no pooled look yet, refuses; so does a room that has taken neither look. The condition is recorded in every values and stop file; the summary refuses unless all jobs share it, and prints it first (changes C2, C3)

marks.channel_open: 'The channel is open' iff, on the gapped critic's actor in the stalling world with the clip fallback, pooled over seeds 0-4 (mean of the per-seed paired differences, every seed present): (i) points(perfect detector -> clip) - points(random at its own rate -> clip) >= 15 in strong current or in big kicks, and (ii) points(actor alone) - points(perfect detector -> clip) <= 3 in recorded conditions
reported: the same reading for plain TD3+BC in the stalling world
for every trigger, fallback and job: trigger minus random at its own rate, change from the actor alone, cost in recorded conditions, catch rate and precision on past-80% proposals, share switched

for every trigger: whether it clears the channel-open bar (>= 15 over random in strong current or in big kicks, cost <= 3; plan 4.3) and plan 5.3's Stage-2 bar (>= 10 over random in strong current only, because plan 5.3 reads its marks in strong current unless it says otherwise; cost <= 2) (change C1)
seed counts (positive seeds) and standard errors over seeds
the launch condition shared by every job, first in summary.json and in tables.md (change C3)
the shape readout of every trigger, pooled over seeds (shape_readout; gates nothing; change C4)
marks.selectivity: reported, for three actor pairs (gapped critic's actor of each world; the stalling world's gapped critic's actor in both worlds; plain TD3+BC in both worlds), every trigger, fallback and situation, pooled over seeds: stalling-world gain minus no-stall loss = (T - alone)_stall + (T - alone)_no_stall; targeting = (T - random_T)_stall + (T - random_T)_no_stall; the same sum for clipping every step; catch-rate selectivity = catch rate of past-80% proposals, stalling minus no-stall

no_bca: No BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update is fitted, read or called. Nothing from algorithms/td3_bc_bca.py or learners.bca_* is called. From calibration/ only calibration/bank.stratified_bank runs, because the gate's data loader (experiments/shift/dataset.py through acceptance.load_seed) calls it to regenerate the log's calibration-bank split (a NumPy row sampler). The refusal limit l* of the reported ratio_refuse trigger is the generic weighted split-conformal formula, computed in NumPy from classifier weights; no BCA code.
outcome_leakage: Only saved check-2 actors, the gate's frozen fixed-controller critics, cloned actors and logs, and the fallback diagnostic's machinery are used. No room-test values, futility, lock or log file is read. At launch a full job reads only the three pass flags of the room's pooled.json, or, when that file does not exist, only the stop flag of the room's futility.json (the launch condition, change C2); nothing computed depends on them. The smoke check withholds every point value.
per_rule_outputs: recall_past80 (share of past-80% proposals on which the rule fired)
precision_past80 (share of firings on past-80% proposals)

Both are executed in memory (no bytecode written).

A, L, TC, RC, TR (the gate modules it imports)

pooling: paired by seed (and by start within a seed); mean over seeds 0-4; standard error over seeds, ddof 1

random_control.coin_seed: default_rng([20261013, seed, 91, world index, actor tag, situation index, fallback index, trigger index])
random_control.rule: for every trigger T and fallback F: a coin per start and step that fires with probability equal to the share of (start, step) pairs on which T -> F fired, for the same seed, world, actor, situation and fallback; the fallback is then applied exactly as for T

setup.actors_source: check 2's saved actors: runs/shift/<prereg>/harm_return/base/alpha5/seed<k>/actors.msgpack, verified by the SHA-256 in its values.json (room harness SeedContext.h2)
setup.deployment_world_parts: the deployment world's physics, gapped training rows, held-out rows, frozen fixed-controller gapped critic (acceptance.get_critic(prereg, sd, 'gap', 'stall_aware', train=False)), cloned actor (clone / no_stall_clone) and anchors

jobs.role: the gapped critic's actor (check 2), in its own world; the channel-open mark is read here
plain TD3+BC on the gapped log (check 2's td3bc_gapped), in its own world
the gapped critic's actor of the no-stall world (check 2), in its own world
plain TD3+BC trained on the stalling world's gapped log, deployed in the no-stall world: the gate trained no TD3+BC in the no-stall world (deviation D1)
the stalling world's gapped critic's actor deployed in the no-stall world: the same-actor companion of TD3+BC's no-stall row (reported)

setup.starts: the first 200 starts of each 1,000-start evaluation bank (thruster_chain.bank_starts), the same starts as the fallback diagnostic, for every rule

shape_readout.commands: the deployed actor's command clip(pi(s), -1, 1) with thruster 1 set to sign * m along the actor's own push (sign of its thruster-1 command), the other thrusters at the actor's command; m = 0.8 is the float32 knee (thruster_chain.KNEE), which is not past it
shape_readout.no_return: the frozen critic, the classifier and the neighbour search only: no rollout, no return, no point
per_trigger: share of states whose score falls / rises / stays from 80% to 81% (the room's (e1) reading; the room's 25% limit for penalties is shown for reference only)
mean score at each throttle (not for sa95)
firing rate at each throttle, and at 1.0 minus at 0.8
firing rate at the actor's own command
shape_readout.scores: each trigger's own score and level (Signals.score, Signals.thr); unrec: max_k |a_k|, firing by thruster_chain.past_knee; ratio_refuse: the classifier logit against l*; sa95: the 10th-neighbour distance (fallback.Novelty.dist) at 80% and 81% for the fall share, firing by its exact decision at every throttle
shape_readout.states: the room harness's shape_rows of the deployment world: 2,000 full-throttle-region training states, default_rng([20261015, seed, 65]) (the states of the room's check (e))

smoke: seed-0 check before any full run: every job of seed 0 with the first 20 starts of every bank, every rule; plus a 200-start timing probe in strong current for the gapped critic's actor. Outputs under smoke/; every point value withheld (finiteness and a hash only); the gate check runs as in a full job (its difference only); an equivalence check reruns the rules shared with the fallback diagnostic (never switch, every step to clip and to clone, perfect detector, distance check, a random coin at rate 0.25) through fallback.run_rule and records the largest difference; timing per rule; the shape readout runs as in a full job (it holds no point value). After spec v2: changes_check (the per-start point hashes of every rule equal the v1 smoke's)

density.formula: score = 1/2 sum_k ((a_k - c_k(s)) / sigma_k)^2, c = clip(cloned actor, -1, 1), sigma_k = sqrt(mean_i (a_ik - c_k(s_i))^2) over the gapped training rows; fire iff score > q95 (the plan's penalty [score - q95]_+ is positive)
density.text: behaviour density: 1/2 sum_k ((a_k - c_k(s)) / sigma_k)^2 above its 95% level on held-out recorded pairs

heads.formula: score = |Q1(s, a) - Q2(s, a)| (learners.critic_rows); fire iff score > q95
heads.text: two-head disagreement: |Q1 - Q2|(s, a) above its 95% level on held-out recorded pairs

onestep.formula: score = max(delta*(s, r(s)) - delta*(s, a), 0); fire iff score > q95. delta*(s, a) = r(s, a) + 0.98 * min_h Q_h(s', c(s')) - min_h Q_h(s, a) (room harness oracle64: one float64 step of thruster_chain.dynamics_jax, the frozen float32 critic at float32-rounded normalised states, c = recorder.stall_aware of the world's physics); r(s) = recorder.Recorder(spec, physics)(s): the recording controller's normal-driving command without wobble or the full-throttle command
onestep.text: one-step oracle, re-referenced: [delta*(s, r(s)) - delta*(s, a)]_+ above its 95% level on held-out recorded pairs; r(s) the recording controller's command at s without its wobble

onestep_clone.formula: as onestep with r(s) replaced by clip(c(s), -1, 1), c the world's cloned actor
onestep_clone.text: one-step oracle re-referenced to the cloned actor: [delta*(s, c(s)) - delta*(s, a)]_+ above its 95% level

onestep_lit.formula: score = |delta*(s, a)|; fire iff score > q95
onestep_lit.text: the plan's literal one-step trigger: |delta*(s, a)| above its 95% level on held-out recorded pairs

ratio.formula: score = logit g(normalise(s), a); g fitted by logistic loss to label 0 at (s_i, a_i) and label 1 at (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) for every gapped training row i (equal class sizes, so the logit is log w); pi the deployed actor (its own input normalisation), c the world's cloned actor; 2 hidden layers of 128 (ReLU), 10,000 Adam steps, learning rate 0.001, batch 512, rows drawn by default_rng([20261013, seed, 81, world index, actor tag]), init key from the same stream; fitted once per seed, world and actor; fire iff score > q95
ratio.text: classifier ratio: log w_g(s, a) above its 95% level on held-out recorded pairs

ratio_refuse.formula: fire iff logit g(s, a) > l* = log(0.1 / 0.9) + log sum_j exp(logit g(s_j, a_j)) over the world's gapped calibration-bank rows (Prepared.bank_rows)
ratio_refuse.text: classifier ratio above plan 4.2's limit l* (score-free refusal of weighted split conformal at 0.1)

sa95.formula: fallback.Reference.sa.novel: the 10th-nearest-neighbour distance of (s, a) to the gapped training (state, command) rows in standard units above the fallback diagnostic's 95% split-conformal level
sa95.text: distance check carried over from the fallback diagnostic: (state, command) 10th-neighbour distance above its 95% level

unrec.formula: fire iff max_k |a_k| > 0.800000011920929 (thruster_chain.past_knee; the knee in both worlds)
unrec.text: perfect detector: fires when the actor proposes past 80% on any thruster (uses knowledge of the gap)
